grid_profile.src: 22 s8: three broad bumps 1.5/2.5/3.6 kHz, Q 4 (+6/+4/+2 dB) over a floor 12 dB lower (bumps are floor+18/16/14 dB here, floor -24 dB absolute = reference -12 dB), rolled off above 5 kHz (-12 dB/oct design), all positive, centred

decay_scale.note: radiation bumps behind the loop: x0.5..2 over the Decay dial

damping.src: 22 s8: bell bumps alphaG 0, alphaR 125e-3 (Q 4 flat), rho 0.10, T200 0.044 s

contact.note: Position = radiation tap offset, default half period (BODY:345); Coupling = radiation mix, loop gain stays Decay's

line.src: BODY:520 loop low-pass 1.75 kHz, :55 buffer; radiation 1.4 kHz measured 1150-1450 Hz (R10 B4); dispersion -0.05 'slight' design

calibration.src: BODY:831 wet = 0.149448188*(3.8*boreRadiation); energy_target unused (no slots); P2 calibration: out_gain 0.1494 -> 0.07 (pre-AGC level -6.6 dB, the AGC then runs higher in its range like BODY, pink LUFS +1.1 -> -0.2 dB), see docs/dev/05_LINE_A.md section 9

touch.src: 20 s5 Touch, task P3: 50 = recipe sustain, 0 = sustain x 0.1, 100 = 1.0, log-interpolated

position.src: 22 s8: radiation tap offset in periods behind the loop read, 50 = 0.5 (BODY:345)

bright.src: 20 s5 Bright: reed low-pass x 0.5..2 + upper-mode tilt

stretch.src: 20 s5 Stretch: f' = 1000 (f/1000)^(1+s), s = -0.3..+0.3 (Sculpture Formant Stretch); following modes: ratio^(1+s)

stiffness.src: 22 s13: bore dispersion, first-order allpass +-0.8 (+ = flat upper partials as a real bore, - = sharp); a first-order allpass needs |a| near 0.8 for a few percent at the 7th partial, +-0.1 changes nothing audible (measured)

coupling.src: 22 s13: radiation mix: 0 = direct pickup, 50 = recipe radiation filter, 100 = filter cutoff x 0.36; feed to the grid 0..2x

air.src: 22 s13: breath noise 0..0.3 of the reed envelope (BODY has none: 0..50 inert)

reed.src: 20 s15: soft-clip strength (BODY:649 0.90) and reed asymmetry 0..0.15

width.src: 20 s5 Width: radiation tap L/R offset

depth.filled_note: path not stated in 22; set to the mean of the stated detail paths 3-9 (design)
